rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved or Board-recognized continuing education contact hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: If one year or less remains in the license period at initial advanced practice approval, the pharmacology hours are not required for the first advanced practice renewal.
rules.alternatives: Approval also depends on national certification: it expires before the RN license if the national certification expires during the license period.

topics.who: CRNPs and CNMs with prescriptive authority (pharmacology specific to prescriptive practice), CRNAs and CNSs
CRNPs and CNMs holding a Qualified Alabama Controlled Substances Registration Certificate (QACSC)

rules.notes: The 6 pharmacology hours are part of the 24 RN contact hours, not extra. APRN approval renews with the RN license: single-state RNs by Dec 31 of even years, multistate RNs by Dec 31 of odd years. QACSC holders need 4 AMA PRA Cat 1 or equivalent controlled-substance credits every 2 years.
